title.evidence_quote: announces the opening of a Simons-FAPESP research professor position in the area of cosmology/gravitational waves

institution.name: ICTP South American Institute for Fundamental Research (ICTP-SAIFR)

qualifications: Area: cosmology/gravitational waves; outstanding candidates from other areas may also apply
Apply with cover letter, names of at least three recommenders, CV, research project and publication list
Duties include research, organising activities, and teaching and supervising Master's and PhD students at IFT-UNESP
Successful candidates will be highly considered for a tenured position in cosmology/gravitational waves at ICTP-SAIFR/IFT-UNESP in 2027
description_short: ICTP-SAIFR in São Paulo is recruiting a Simons-FAPESP research professor in cosmology/gravitational waves, with a path to a tenured position at ICTP-SAIFR/IFT-UNESP. Candidates are strongly encouraged to apply before 22 January 2027.
